title: I’m sorry
blurb: Apologizing so that it lands, and answering an apology

steps.title: Which of these have you heard, or said?
Слова урока
steps.sub: Нажми на карточку, чтобы увидеть перевод

words.def: somebody being considered for a job or a position
having very strong feelings about something
to prevent somebody from doing something

steps.title: Выбери правильный перевод
options: кандидат
страстный, увлечённый
помешать кому-то сделать

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html: I’d like to apologize for the email I sent yesterday.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html: It was my fault. I replied in about ninety seconds.

steps.title: Как это работает
steps.html: I should never have copied in the whole team.

steps.prompt: Why does the first one not work as an apology?
options: it is too short
it is too formal
if makes the offence hypothetical, and but moves the blame
it should have used apologize instead of sorry
steps.answer: if makes the offence hypothetical, and but moves the blame

steps.title: Does the apology match the situation? Choose.
steps.prompt: You arrive two minutes late for coffee with a friend. ____
options: I must apologize unreservedly for this delay.
Sorry, the bus was late.
Please accept my sincerest apologies for my inexcusable behaviour.

steps.title: Does the apology match the situation? Choose.
steps.prompt: You missed a client meeting completely. ____
options: Sorry about that!
These things happen, don’t they?
I’d like to apologize — I take full responsibility.
steps.answer: I’d like to apologize — I take full responsibility.

steps.title: Does the apology match the situation? Choose.
steps.prompt: You forwarded a private message by mistake. ____
options: I’m so sorry — I should never have sent it on.
I’m sorry if you were offended.
It was only a message, after all.
steps.answer: I’m so sorry — I should never have sent it on.

steps.title: Does the apology match the situation? Choose.
steps.prompt: Your colleague apologizes for a five-minute delay. ____
options: I’d rather you didn’t do it again.
Don’t worry, these things happen.
I hope it won’t happen again.

steps.title: What would you say? Choose the better version.
steps.prompt: You were twenty minutes late meeting a friend.
options: I’m sorry if you had to wait.
Sorry about that — the bus never came.
I’d like to apologize for the inconvenience caused.
steps.answer: Sorry about that — the bus never came.

steps.title: What would you say? Choose the better version.
steps.prompt: You sent a customer the wrong order.
options: Sorry about that.
I’m sorry but the system is very old.
I’d like to apologize for the mistake. Please accept my apologies for any inconvenience.
steps.answer: I’d like to apologize for the mistake. Please accept my apologies for any inconvenience.

steps.title: What would you say? Choose the better version.
steps.prompt: You said something unfair about a colleague in front of others.
options: I’m really sorry about what I said. It was my fault and I should never have said it in front of everybody.
I’m sorry if that came across badly.
Mistakes were made yesterday.
steps.answer: I’m really sorry about what I said. It was my fault and I should never have said it in front of everybody.

steps.title: What would you say? Choose the better version.
steps.prompt: A friend apologizes for forgetting your birthday.
options: Yes, you should have remembered.
Don’t worry, these things happen.
Thank you for letting me know.

steps.title: Check your own message. Which of them did you do?
steps.model: Apologizing: I’m really sorry about… · It was my fault · I should never have… · That was careless of me · I’d like to apologize for… · Please accept my apologies

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ apologize at three levels — Sorry about that to Please accept my apologies
✓ use sorry for/about and apologize for correctly — never apologize you
✓ accept the fault — It was my fault / That was careless of me
✓ name the exact thing instead of apologizing for “my tone”
✓ avoid but and sorry if , which cancel an apology
✓ answer an apology — Don’t worry, these things happen / No harm done
